calendar.sample_time_definition: nominal capture time n/Fs-capture_lead_seconds; unknown physical RX clock retained in channel

channel.phase_convention: triad_long: independent active RF uses hypot(base,shift); zero RF or shared reference uses base; relative diffusion divided by sqrt(2) per endpoint
channel.random_doppler_width_definition: B=2sigma of each ray Gaussian spectrum; independent of ray center separation
channel.selective_depth_definition: bounded peak excursion; each component has uniform marginal and RMS depth/sqrt(3)
channel.delay_motion_doppler_bound_scope: nominal carrier plus entire source Nyquist interval; includes envelope time-warp as well as propagation phase
channel.random_sampling_policy: fixed physical-time knots at16*B; variance-normalized cubic interpolation; stationary indexed innovations independent of receiver sample rate and chunk boundaries
channel.random_spectral_allowance_scope: engineering spectral-tail allowance, not compact support or a physical measurement; delay-motion Doppler is additional and is counted once
channel.bandwidth_scope: Source/capture preflight retains nominal design width plus the complete legacy 2/ramp allowance and declared 200-Hz skirt; only the Helper placement band uses the key-independent shaping certificate. Finite pulse, gated transmission and stochastic channel spectra are not compact support.
channel.data_if_default_reason: Legacy fixtures preserve HF1725Hz and EME4000Hz defaults. Auto shaping starts at standardized1725Hz; explicit DATA IF takes precedence.
channel.composition: production Helper Generator and DATA summed before shared TX oscillator, spread, dispersive selective stage, RX oscillator and noise; no post-channel hop gate

power.data_reference_scope: fixed public bit0 before channel; full active tiles including nonzero ramps; excluding FHSS quiet and burst waits; all bits, epochs and controls retain this gain; refinement difference is not a proven integration bound
power.helper_component_reference_policy: full production Helper power reference retained; diagnostic component removal does not redistribute power; actual emitted component energy is reported separately
power.reference_scope: 39-41s preview belongs to production Helper planning only; measured Helper norm is relative to nominal active DATA norm1; DATA normalization follows data_power_reference_policy

pilot_timing_guard.planning_model: Equal-tone first-lobe cos^2(pi*W*delta); W spans nominal DATA band and selected pilots.
pilot_timing_guard.limitation: Engineering phase-resolution policy only, not a bound on actual stochastic-channel sensitivity loss.
pilot_timing_guard.clock_time_bound_scope: Maximum absolute nominal source coordinate over public capture, arrival and excess-delay bounds.

acquisition.mixture: Equal selected-Cartesian candidate prior under H0 and both bits; the complete bank is used when no per-trial subset is supplied.
acquisition.projection_scope: One full-bank public projection shared by every tile; core is explicitly lossy.
acquisition.scope: Finite public timing/frequency/clock/epoch bank. No continuous-grid or operational admission guarantee.

frequency.statistic: Hann periodogram working Whittle profile; independent nonnegative Gaussian ray powers and background per pilot
frequency.interval_kind: engineering competitive regions plus declared allowances; not calibrated confidence
frequency.drift_scope: Default zero drift matches the native exporter constant-frequency oscillator model; configure nonzero drift for other sources.
frequency.future_scope: Wiener average frequency over declared finite apertures, union allowance over future horizon; no instantaneous-frequency bound.
frequency.calibration: Freeze and calibrate complete selection/fallback procedure, including one-pilot use, on independent matching captures.

adaptive_policy.clock_policy: Preserve the complete public clock bank; frequency selection grants no clock estimate.
adaptive_policy.projection_policy: Preserve the complete original frequency/clock bank projection for every capture.
adaptive_policy.horizon_policy: A narrowed frequency region must cover the entire scored capture; expired regions revert to the complete bank.
adaptive_policy.calibration_scope: Complete adaptive frequency selection, fallback and independent phase guard; no inherited gate or operational false-admission guarantee.

scope: Finite sampled captures, declared timing/epoch/clock banks and the bound adaptive frequency policy. Admission uses an exchangeable empirical calibration rank gate; this is not an operational false-alarm bound.
